identityBoundary.applicant: National root authenticated session may save draft and submit claims; it does not prove legal company registration or manager authority.
identityBoundary.reviewer: Independent legal reviewer authority must be established by a real appointing body, evidence of delegation, expiry, revocation and actor separation.
forbidden: implicit manager role by OTP or national root

workflow.draft: Versioned, authenticated, nonlegal claim, one per reserved workspace
workflow.submit: PENDING_LEGAL_REVIEW; unique workspace+national ID; no Tenant or role
transitions: IN_REVIEW -> EXTERNAL_APPROVAL_REQUIRED (requires independent verified mandate; not yet source-approved)

evidence.transport: authenticated same-origin JSON relay with body cap and no-store
evidence.serverProtection: AES-256-GCM, independently configured 256-bit server-only key, random per-upload IV; ciphertext and hash persisted in unexposed, RLS-forced table
unimplementedRequiredControls: independent signer identity and authority verification

prohibitions: No hosted Preview migration without independent data-safety review
No live documents while encryption/scanner/provider controls incomplete
No real share, payment, wallet, or general accounting
No new fictional cooperative, Tenant, or manager
